  WHY: This function materializes review runtime files and leaves this import-hijack-able path unprotected.

  WHY: Consumer repos with existing custom fields at the top level or inside `slots` fail `validate_manifest()`; the linked issue explicitly requires rejecting unknown manifest fields, so this is the intended behavior change to surface.
